summary: The two edits are identical and carry every part of the intent. Both add two details the intent does not give: a file path for the Slots type and the callback name onMonthChange. Both also state the slot-data requirement twice.

findings.detail: "Add the shared `Slots` type in packages/features/bookings/types.ts": the intent says only "Add the shared `Slots` type" and names no file. The path is a placement choice that the intent leaves open.
"month changes go through the existing month-change callback (`onMonthChange`)": the intent says "the existing month-change callback" and does not name `onMonthChange`.

"keep the actual slot data available to the calendar for rendering and out-of-office information" is on calendar-weekly-view, and the new edge restates it as "passes the actual slot data (`slots`) to the calendar DatePicker for rendering and out-of-office information". The edge also repeats the month-change-callback rule from booker-ui.
